post.content:
A guy who can't die tries to die, joins the X-Men for about four minutes, goes to mutant prison, gets shot at by a grumpy time traveller, builds the worst superhero team in history, and grows baby legs. All in one movie. 👶🦵

This is Deadpool 2 (the Super Duper Cut), DUMBED DOWN: the whole story explained, every twist, the ending, the coin, and both end-credit fixes. Plus way too many cartoon cutaway gags.

New to Marvel? Perfect. You don't need to have watched anything to follow this.
